claimBoundary: No outcome data are present. This protocol does not support a superiority, speed, or cost claim.

calibration.purpose: Prove platform capture, billing retention, and blinded-packet usability before scoring runs.

requiredEvidence.billing: not part of native quality/resource admission; a separately frozen USD-cost extension requires a retained provider usage export or invoice allocation plus immutable price card
requiredEvidence.timing: separate adapter and verifier wall times
requiredEvidence.admission: exact trial binding plus file-level and manifest-level SHA-256 verification
requiredEvidence.tokenEnforcement: The adapter stops at the first streamed provider usage report over a frozen token ceiling. A final trace is the admission authority; because a provider may report only at a turn boundary, streaming enforcement cannot prove that no unreported excess was consumed.

analysis.primaryOutcome: blinded paired design-quality score on a 0-100 rubric
analysis.secondaryMultiplicity: Holm correction within task-level secondary outcomes
analysis.missingData: report every failure and exclusion; no imputation
analysis.humanEvidence: required for an independent practitioner-design claim

freezePrerequisites: candidate source revision and source-state attestation
three fixture revisions and task-manifest SHA-256 values
provider, model, reasoning effort, and token ceilings
working native capture collectors for all three platforms
measured billing export and price-card retention procedure
